title: Mr. Kato Goes to Work
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Dr. Kato through his busy day at Soroti Hospital, helping patients from town and nearby villages.
keywords: doctor, hospital, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father
dedication: For all the fathers who work hard to care for their families.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: What does a doctor do all day? Join Mr. Kato as he wakes up early, travels to the hospital, and helps many patients. A heartwarming story about a father's love for his family and his community.
